explanation: A session is engaged when it lasts longer than the timer (10 seconds by default, settable from 10 to 60), has a key event, or has 2 or more page or screen views. A longer timer means fewer sessions qualify, so engagement rate falls and bounce rate, which is 100% minus engagement rate, rises with it, without any change in visitors. The session timeout is a separate setting, and GA4 bounce rate is not the single-page definition.
